 1 minute read The Asia Artist Awards 2026 Sells Out 100,000 Seats, Announces Disney Plus Livestream 
 krishkim November 6, 2026 
 Credit: Asia Artist Awards 
 The 2026 Asia Artist Awards (AAA) will stream exclusively worldwide on Disney Plus, with all 100,000 seats for the two-day event already sold out.
 The annual awards show, which recognizes achievements in music, television and film, will take place on December 5th and 6th at Kaohsiung National Stadium in Taiwan. Local broadcaster SETTV will also air the event on a one-hour delay.
 Red carpet coverage will begin at 3 PM local time on both days, followed by the main ceremonies at 5 PM.
 IVE’s Jang Wonyoung will return as host for the sixth consecutive year, joined by actor Ji Chang Wook , ZEROBASEONE’s Sung Hanbin and TWICE’s Tzuyu. Sung returns to the hosting lineup after a two-year absence.
 The event’s acting lineup includes Kim Soo Hyun , Byeon Woo Seok , Kim You Jung , Kim Hye Yoon , Kim Seon Ho , Go Youn Jung , Ahn Hyo Seop , Park Ji Hoon , Choo Young Woo , Hyeri and TWICE’s Dahyun , alongside Japanese actor Shunsuke Michieda.
 The music lineup features TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ATEEZ, RIIZE, MONSTA X, ITZY, NMIXX, ZEROBASEONE, TWS, &TEAM, NEXZ, KISS OF LIFE, Hearts2Hearts, CORTIS, tripleS and KiiiKiii, among others.
 Solo performers include WOODZ, YENA, DAY6’s Wonpil, MONSTA X’s Joohoney, TXT’s Yeonjun and WJSN’s Dayoung.
 Credit: Asia Artist Awards 
 AAA 2026 is hosted by StarNews and organized by the AAA Organizing Committee in partnership with MOTIVE and D-SOW.
